roadmap.title: Establish the cult and defeat Leshy
roadmap.description: Learn the cult systems and win against Ratau early. Start collecting forms, cards, and talisman fragments as their locations open.

roadmap.title: Defeat the remaining Bishops and the final boss
roadmap.description: Expand to twenty followers, cure Sozo, and finish the four Knucklebones opponents before the Fox’s last deal. Start Sin upgrades and breeding after the third Bishop.

roadmap.title: Complete the postgame and base-game collections
roadmap.description: Recruit the Bishops, finish their quests, reunite Aym and Baal with Forneus, and finish Purgatory. Get Shake Down before entering Ewefall; protect unique followers until their tasks are complete.

roadmap.title: Restore Woolhaven
roadmap.description: The paid Woolhaven expansion is required for this phase. Follow its story, restore residents and their buildings, collect Legendary Weapons and Flockade pieces, and fill the village flower pots.

achievements.description: The first devotee to the Cult of the Lamb.
achievements.summary: Indoctrinate the first follower into the cult.

steps.text: Rescue the tutorial follower and indoctrinate them at your cult’s arrival circle.

achievements.description: A deal that cannot be undone.
achievements.summary: Accept the pact with The One Who Waits.

steps.text: Play through the opening execution and accept @npc{The One Who Waits}’s pact.

achievements.summary: Choose the cult’s first doctrine.

steps.text: Use the @loc{Temple} altar to establish your first doctrine.

achievements.summary: Have a follower die for the first time.

steps.text: Let a follower reach the end of their life; a death from another cause also counts.

achievements.summary: Defeat Amdusias, the first miniboss in Darkwood.

steps.text: Finish the first @loc{Darkwood} crusade by defeating @enemy{Amdusias}.

achievements.summary: Have 5 living followers in the cult at once.

steps.text: Rescue followers on crusades or buy recruits from @npc{Helob} until 5 are living in your cult together.

achievements.summary: Have 10 living followers in the cult at once.

steps.text: Rescue followers on crusades or buy recruits from @npc{Helob} until 10 are living in your cult together.

achievements.summary: Have 20 living followers in the cult at once.

steps.text: Rescue followers on crusades or buy recruits from @npc{Helob} until 20 are living in your cult together.

achievements.summary: Defeat Leshy, the Bishop of Darkwood.

steps.text: Complete @loc{Darkwood}’s crusades and defeat @enemy{Leshy} at the end of the region.

achievements.summary: Defeat Heket, the Bishop of Anura.

steps.text: Complete @loc{Anura}’s crusades and defeat @enemy{Heket} at the end of the region.

achievements.summary: Defeat Kallamar, the Bishop of Anchordeep.

steps.text: Complete @loc{Anchordeep}’s crusades and defeat @enemy{Kallamar} at the end of the region.

achievements.summary: Defeat Shamura, the Bishop of Silk Cradle.

steps.text: Complete @loc{Silk Cradle}’s crusades and defeat @enemy{Shamura} at the end of the region.

achievements.summary: Defeat The One Who Waits.

steps.text: After defeating the four Bishops, bring a cult of @item{20 followers} to the final gate.
When @npc{The One Who Waits} demands your sacrifice, choose @warn{Refuse} and win the ensuing battle.

achievements.summary: Defeat Leshy without suffering damage during the boss fight.

steps.text: Fight @enemy{Leshy} without taking a hit. Dodge attacks before committing to your own strikes.
If you get hit, finish or leave the attempt and try again. In @loc{Darkwood}, destroy a Bishop statue during a later crusade and use its portal for a rematch.

achievements.summary: Defeat Heket without suffering damage during the boss fight.

steps.text: Fight @enemy{Heket} without taking a hit. Dodge attacks before committing to your own strikes.
If you get hit, finish or leave the attempt and try again. In @loc{Anura}, destroy a Bishop statue during a later crusade and use its portal for a rematch.

achievements.summary: Defeat Kallamar without suffering damage during the boss fight.

steps.text: Fight @enemy{Kallamar} without taking a hit. Dodge attacks before committing to your own strikes.
If you get hit, finish or leave the attempt and try again. In @loc{Anchordeep}, destroy a Bishop statue during a later crusade and use its portal for a rematch.

achievements.summary: Defeat Shamura without suffering damage during the boss fight.

steps.text: Fight @enemy{Shamura} without taking a hit. Dodge attacks before committing to your own strikes.
If you get hit, finish or leave the attempt and try again. In @loc{Silk Cradle}, destroy a Bishop statue during a later crusade and use its portal for a rematch.

achievements.summary: Hear a follower’s confession at a Confession Booth.

steps.text: Unlock @mechanic{Confession Booth} in the Divine Inspiration tree and build one.
Use the booth and select a follower to hear their confession.

achievements.summary: Discover the five base-game destinations outside the cult.

steps.text: Visit @loc{Lonely Shack} after Ratau’s invitation.
Speak to the Fisherman in @loc{Darkwood}, the Mushroomos in @loc{Anura}, and Plimbo in @loc{Anchordeep}. Find the golden sign in @loc{Silk Cradle} to reveal the remaining destinations.

achievements.summary: Relight the lighthouse at Pilgrim’s Passage.

steps.text: Meet the Fisherman in @loc{Darkwood} to open @loc{Pilgrim’s Passage}.
Speak to the @npc{Lighthouse Keeper} inside the lighthouse and supply @item{15 Lumber} to its furnace.

achievements.summary: Unlock the full base-game collection of follower forms.

guide.context: The paid follower packs are unnecessary. Unlock forms by acquiring them; you do not need to keep a living follower of every species.

collectibles.note: Trade a fish other than a Minnow, then one follower, then two followers or half a red heart, then Ratau. Beat Ratau at Knucklebones before the last trade. If a moon mark is absent, try another night.

achievements.summary: Perform the cult’s first ritual.

steps.text: Perform an available ritual at the @loc{Temple} altar.

achievements.summary: Perform Sacrifice of the Flesh on one follower.

steps.text: At the @loc{Temple}, perform @mechanic{Sacrifice of the Flesh} and choose a follower.

achievements.summary: Use Sacrifice of the Flesh to sacrifice ten followers.

steps.text: Perform @mechanic{Sacrifice of the Flesh} ten times at the @loc{Temple}. Wait for the ritual’s cooldown between sacrifices.

achievements.summary: Hold at least 666 gold coins at one time.

steps.text: Save crusade rewards and sales income until your wallet contains @item{666 gold coins} or more.

achievements.summary: Unlock every weapon upgrade in the sermon progression tree.

steps.text: Hold sermons at the @loc{Temple} and spend their upgrade points on every weapon branch.

achievements.summary: Unlock every curse upgrade in the sermon progression tree.

steps.text: Spend @loc{Temple} sermon points on each curse branch until the curse upgrades are complete.

achievements.summary: Unlock Cult IV in the Divine Inspiration tree.

steps.text: Collect shrine Devotion, spend Divine Inspiration on the required unlocks, and buy @mechanic{Cult IV} at the top of the tree.

achievements.summary: Unlock one additional fleece for the Lamb.

steps.text: Meet the Fisherman in @loc{Darkwood}, then visit him at @loc{Pilgrim’s Passage}. Catch a @item{Crab}, @item{Lobster}, @item{Squid}, and @item{Octopus} for his requests.
Give him one of each requested fish to earn @item{four Holy Talisman fragments}. Spend the completed talisman on a fleece at the @loc{Temple} altar.

achievements.summary: Unlock the complete base-game fleece collection.

guide.context: Four fragments make one Holy Talisman. The nine talisman fleeces cost 36 fragments altogether. The fragment tasks below supply that total; the other fleeces use their own unlock methods.

collectibles.name: Fisherman: four fragments
collectibles.method: Catch a Crab, Lobster, Squid, and Octopus. Give one of each to the Fisherman for four fragments.

collectibles.name: Sozo: four fragments
collectibles.method: Give Sozo 10 Menticide Mushrooms, then 20 more. Perform his Brainwashing Ritual, build the Mushroom Sculpture, and return to Sozo to finish his requests.

collectibles.name: Original Witnesses: four fragments
collectibles.location: The four original regions, then Smuggler’s Sanctuary
collectibles.method: After defeating each region’s Bishop, complete another crusade there to fight its Witness. Bring each @item{Eye of the Witness} to @npc{Plimbo} at Smuggler’s Sanctuary.

collectibles.name: Postgame Witnesses: four fragments
collectibles.location: The four reopened regions, then Smuggler’s Sanctuary
collectibles.method: On postgame crusades, defeat the new Witness in each region. Trade their four eyes to Plimbo at Smuggler’s Sanctuary.

collectibles.name: Midas: four fragments
collectibles.method: Offer four followers at Midas’s sacrifice altar, receiving one fragment per follower. Keep unique followers needed for other tasks.

collectibles.name: Mystic Seller: twelve fragments
collectibles.location: Mystic Seller after The One Who Waits
collectibles.method: Trade @item{God Tears} at the reward wheel until you receive its twelve talisman fragments.

collectibles.name: Fox: first trade
collectibles.method: At night, find the green moon mark and select @mechanic{Peer into the Darkness}. Give the Fox any fish except a Minnow for one fragment.
collectibles.note: If the moon mark is absent, visit on another night.

collectibles.name: Fox: second trade
collectibles.location: Left of Spore Grotto’s decoration shop
collectibles.method: Use the moon mark’s @mechanic{Peer into the Darkness} prompt at night. Give the Fox one follower for a fragment.

collectibles.name: Fox: third trade
collectibles.location: Right of Smuggler’s Sanctuary’s decoration shop
collectibles.method: At the moon mark at night, select @mechanic{Peer into the Darkness}. Trade two followers or permanently give up half a red heart for a fragment.

collectibles.name: Fox: final trade
collectibles.method: Win Ratau’s Knucklebones game before returning here at night. Use @mechanic{Peer into the Darkness} at the moon mark and sacrifice Ratau for the last fragment.

achievements.summary: Have a follower or the Lamb eat a Minced Follower Meat meal.

steps.text: Harvest a dead follower for @item{Follower Meat}, then cook @item{Minced Follower Meat}.
Order a follower to eat the meal.

achievements.summary: Purchase every upgrade in the Temple’s sermon tree.

steps.text: Give sermons and use the earned points to finish every branch of the @loc{Temple} upgrade tree.

achievements.summary: Win one game of Knucklebones.

steps.text: Visit @npc{Ratau} at @loc{Lonely Shack} and beat him at Knucklebones. Match dice within your columns and erase opposing matches.

achievements.summary: Beat every named Knucklebones opponent at Lonely Shack.

steps.text: Beat @npc{Ratau} before accepting the Fox’s final deal to sacrifice him.
Invite @npc{Flinky} from Anura, @npc{Klunko and Bop} from Anchordeep, and @npc{Shrumy} from Silk Cradle. Beat each at @loc{Lonely Shack}.

achievements.description: No longer a servant, no less than a God.

steps.text: Finish the remaining base-game achievements, including the free-update collections and challenges.

collectibles.name: Warracka’s Right Fist

achievements.description: Get your Gold back from Midas.
achievements.summary: Attack Midas during his third postgame robbery and recover stolen gold.

steps.text: After the main story, find @npc{Midas} robbing you in @loc{Darkwood}, then @loc{Anchordeep}.
At the third robbery in @loc{Silk Cradle}, hit Midas while he remains in the room and collect the coins he drops. Finish this before exploring @loc{Ewefall}.

achievements.description: Reunite Aym and Baal with their mother, Forneus.
achievements.summary: Reunite Aym and Baal with their mother, Forneus.

guide.context: Keep Aym and Baal safe until their reunion. If either dies, resurrect him; do not give either brother to Midas, a region door, or the Fox.

steps.text: Trade @item{God Tears} with @npc{???} until you receive the @item{Light Necklace} and @item{Dark Necklace}.
Give the Light Necklace to a follower and use @mechanic{Sacrifice of the Flesh} to summon @npc{Baal}. Sacrifice a follower wearing the Dark Necklace in the same ritual to summon @npc{Aym}.
Use @mechanic{Demonic Summoning Circle II} or III to take Aym and Baal as demons on a crusade. Enter @npc{Forneus}’s shop, marked by the cat beneath its shop icon, to return them.

achievements.summary: Clear all six challenges in one fleece’s Dungeon Gauntlet row in Purgatory.

guide.context: Demons cannot enter Purgatory. Meal bonuses and Empowered Shrine of Disciples bonuses can help you survive the longer runs.

steps.text: After finishing the main story, clear postgame @loc{Darkwood} and speak to @npc{???} to open @loc{Purgatory}.
Choose @mechanic{Dungeon Gauntlet} and keep completing the same fleece’s row until all @item{six challenges} are cleared. The starting Fleece of the Lamb works.
Return on later in-game days as the portal recharges. If a run fails, retry its challenge.

achievements.description: Indoctrinate Leshy, Heket, Kallamar, Shamura, and Narinder into the cult.
achievements.summary: Indoctrinate Leshy, Heket, Kallamar, Shamura, and Narinder into the cult.

steps.text: After defeating @npc{The One Who Waits}, speak to @npc{???} and reopen the four regions with the follower sacrifices shown at their doors.
Defeat each Bishop again and indoctrinate @npc{Leshy}, @npc{Heket}, @npc{Kallamar}, and @npc{Shamura}.
Spare and indoctrinate @npc{Narinder} after the original final battle. If you killed him, collect him from @npc{???} after recruiting the other four Bishops.

achievements.summary: Collect ten Ancient Tablets and the five original lore notes.

guide.context: Search after defeating The One Who Waits. Bring red hearts for the tablet shrines; the Telescope tarot card helps reveal their hidden rooms.

collectibles.method: Strike the small crown totem to open the hidden passage, then give the shrine @item{one red heart}. Tablets arrive in sequence.

collectibles.name: Ripped Note

achievements.summary: Unlock every follower outfit design from the base game.

guide.context: Defeat the third Bishop, meet Berith on a crusade, and unlock the Tailor through Divine Inspiration. Acolyte Robes, Peasant Blouse, and Laborer Tunic start unlocked. Paid-pack outfits are unnecessary.

collectibles.name: Merchant Shirt

achievements.summary: Have twelve followers appointed as Disciples at the same time.

steps.text: Raise followers to at least @item{loyalty level 10}. When a long-standing follower requests Discipleship, unlock the @mechanic{Ritual of Discipleship}.
Use the ritual to appoint twelve living followers. Keep those Disciples alive until the cult has twelve together.

achievements.summary: Raise the Temple’s cosmetic upgrade level to Icon X.

steps.text: After choosing a Sin doctrine, open the @loc{Temple}’s cosmetic upgrades.
Buy each upgrade through @mechanic{Icon X}. Across Icons II–X, set aside @item{62 Sin} and @item{143 Gold Bars}.

achievements.description: Cure Sozo’s mushroom addiction and restore Dr. Sozonius.
achievements.summary: Cure Sozo’s mushroom addiction and restore Dr. Sozonius.

guide.context: Keep Sozo’s planted mushroom safe until harvest, and keep Sozo in the cult until cured. If he dies, use the Ritual of Resurrection before continuing.

steps.text: Finish @npc{Sozo}’s Spore Grotto requests: give @item{10 Menticide Mushrooms}, then @item{20}, perform the @mechanic{Brainwashing Ritual}, and build the @item{Mushroom Sculpture}.
Return after Sozo dies. Take the mushroom from his head, plant it in a @mechanic{Farm Plot}, and harvest it when grown to recruit Sozo.
Give him @item{5 Menticide Mushrooms}. Refuse his request for a Mushroomo; if you already supplied one, refuse the next request.
Imprison Sozo when he dissents and re-educate him until cured. Release him to complete the transformation.

achievements.summary: Hatch five follower eggs.

steps.text: Unlock and build a @mechanic{Mating Tent} and @mechanic{Hatchery}. Use Sin at the tent to pair adult followers and produce eggs.
Place five successful eggs in hatcheries, tend them, and hatch them when ready. Eggs you crack for food do not count.

achievements.summary: Restore all seven Legendary Weapons.

guide.context: Return Rami’s remains to Woolhaven, rebuild the Forge, and speak to Rami. Restoration starts at 5 Wool and rises by 5 per weapon. For the final fragment, finish the resident boards described below.

collectibles.name: Scourge of Svarog — Hammer
collectibles.method: Restore Rami’s Forge and accept their first weapon request. Find the hammer fragment in a forge room in The Rot, then return it to Rami.

collectibles.name: Golden End — Sword
collectibles.method: Break a Marchosias statue in Ewefall or a Yngya statue in The Rot. Take the fragment to Rami.

collectibles.name: Defiler of the Divine — Gauntlets
collectibles.method: Search behind the frozen corpse in the lower section before the boss fight. If you missed the fragment, return by the Marchosias portal and check the top of the stairs. Bring it to Rami.

collectibles.name: Fate of Plimbo the First — Blunderbuss
collectibles.method: During winter, cross the ice to the large dead fish in the southwest. Enter its body and fish inside for the fragment, then bring it to Rami.

collectibles.name: Lamb’s Slaughter — Axe
collectibles.method: Kill the Executioner and take the axe fragment, or spare her twice and speak to her after she joins the cult. Deliver the fragment to Rami.

collectibles.name: Ruins of Nirah — Dagger
collectibles.location: Heart rooms in The Rot and Ewefall
collectibles.method: Accept Charybdis’s letter in a Rot heart room and deliver it to Scylla in an Ewefall heart room. Buy the Fisherman’s spare rod with Wool at Pilgrim’s Passage during winter. Give the rod to Scylla, then restore her fragment at Rami’s Forge.

collectibles.name: Yngya’s Torment — Flail
collectibles.method: Complete every resident’s quest board. Collect the fragment that drops from the statue’s bell and take it to Rami.
collectibles.note: Baraq: raise and bring the requested animals. Chazaq: accept tasks, then build the requested decorations; check his shop each day for designs. Aniel: finish the Flockade wager tasks. Rami: complete the requested crusades with restored weapons. Sariel: buy resident fleeces with Wool at their graves, then finish the runs his board requests.

collectibles.name: Koka’s board: find Keru and Aza
collectibles.location: Woolhaven and the five destination areas
collectibles.method: Check Baraq’s well; the lamb statue near the cult Temple’s podium; the pirate head inside the frozen fish at Pilgrim’s Passage in winter; the machine left of Sozo by day; the unusual floorboard at Smuggler’s Sanctuary by night; and the gold pile right of Midas’s altar during a blizzard.
collectibles.note: Accept each task on Koka’s board before searching its hiding place.

achievements.summary: Obtain Ratau’s cloak as his legacy.

steps.text: After clearing a @loc{The Rot} crusade, visit the moon mark at @loc{Woolhaven}’s southeast bridge at night.
Give @npc{the Fox} a @item{Rotten follower}. If Ratau is dead, you receive his cloak immediately.
If Ratau is alive, take the staff reward and visit him at @loc{Lonely Shack}. Bet on Knucklebones and win to receive his cloak.

achievements.summary: Indoctrinate Midas into the cult.

steps.text: Finish @mechanic{Shake Down} before exploring Ewefall. When Midas is killed by a wolf in an @loc{Ewefall} encounter, pick up his skull.
Incubate the skull in a @mechanic{Hatchery} and raise Midas to adulthood. He will run away and steal your sermon donations.
After a follower suggests a trap, build a @item{Wolf Trap} and bait it with @item{one Gold Bar}. Hold another sermon.
Return to the trap, re-educate Midas until he submits, and indoctrinate him.

achievements.summary: Collect the complete set of Flockade pieces.

guide.context: Return Aniel’s remains and rebuild her Museum to open Flockade. Restore the other residents as you explore so they become available as opponents.

collectibles.method: Return Aniel’s remains to Woolhaven, then beat Aniel once at Flockade to unlock their normal reward pieces.

collectibles.name: Sariel: first victory

collectibles.name: Aniel: Shepherd piece
collectibles.method: On @npc{Aniel}’s quest board, accept the wager challenge against Aniel. Beat Aniel with a bet of at least @item{1 Wool}, then claim the board reward.

collectibles.method: On @npc{Aniel}’s quest board, accept the wager challenge against Baraq. Beat Baraq with a bet of at least @item{2 Wool}, then claim the board reward.

collectibles.method: On @npc{Aniel}’s quest board, accept the wager challenge against Chazaq. Beat Chazaq with a bet of at least @item{8 Wool}, then claim the board reward.

collectibles.name: Sariel: Shepherd piece
collectibles.method: On @npc{Aniel}’s quest board, accept the wager challenge against Sariel. Beat Sariel with a bet of at least @item{10 Wool}, then claim the board reward.

achievements.summary: Plant flowers in every flower pot around Woolhaven.

steps.text: Explore @loc{Woolhaven} and plant flowers in every empty pot around the village. Check the rebuilt homes, paths, bridge, well, gate, and dock.

achievements.description: Defeat the Executioner in The Rot.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Executioner in The Rot.

steps.text: Advance the @loc{Woolhaven} story until the axe-marked route in @loc{The Rot} opens, then defeat @enemy{the Executioner}.

achievements.summary: Defeat Marchosias in Ewefall.

steps.text: Follow @loc{Woolhaven}’s story through @loc{Ewefall} and defeat @enemy{Marchosias} at the Fallen Temple.

achievements.description: Defeat Yngya at the Heart of the Mountain.
achievements.summary: Defeat Yngya at the Heart of the Mountain.

steps.text: Complete @loc{Woolhaven}’s story routes through Ewefall and The Rot, then defeat @enemy{Yngya} at the @loc{Heart of the Mountain}.

achievements.description: Defeat Yngya without directly attacking her.
achievements.summary: Defeat Yngya without directly attacking her.

steps.text: During the @enemy{Yngya} fight, dodge while she spends her own health spawning enemies. You may attack the minions.
Keep weapons and curses away from Yngya, and @warn{do not knock her bombs back at her}. Survive until her health runs out.
If you hit her, retry. After the story victory, destroy a Yngya statue in @loc{The Rot} and use the portal to fight her again.
